related.title: Spitzer 紅外線望遠鏡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付區域圖、面積比、淨計數與統計適用範圍。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver regions,area ratio,net counts and statistical-validity limits.
related.difference: 用黑體近似比較溫度與輻射峰位置，建立紅外線背景的量級直覺。
related.differenceEn: Use a blackbody approximation to compare temperature and emission peak,building intuition for infrared background.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分開算扣除量 20、淨值 80 與變異數 105，核對 α² 的來源。
將溫度用 K 帶入維恩式，標明縱軸是每單位波長輻亮度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate background contribution 20,net 80 and variance 105 separately,checking the α² factor.
Use K in Wien’s law and label the ordinate as radiance per wavelength.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: XMM-Newton X 射線天文台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付區域圖、面積比、淨計數與統計適用範圍。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver regions,area ratio,net counts and statistical-validity limits.
related.difference: 從高背景時段剔除不適用資料，計算好時間區間與有效計數率。
related.differenceEn: Remove unsuitable high-background intervals and calculate good-time exposure and count rate.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 分開算扣除量 20、淨值 80 與變異數 105，核對 α² 的來源。
刪第三段後同時重算事件和秒數，與錯用 400 s 的結果比較。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate background contribution 20,net 80 and variance 105 separately,checking the α² factor.
Remove the third bin and recompute counts and seconds,comparing with the wrong 400 s denominator.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
